_comment: Everything the DEMO page says. Edit text here; no code change needed. Restart amr.service after editing. near_m: how close (m, from the vehicle outline) counts as 'It sees you'; raise or lower it on site. Each card: icon (scanner, layers, bolt, shield, stop, route, load, panel, speed, map, qr) and color (#RRGGBB, the slide's accent); tags (optional) are short pills under the text. Up to 8 cards.

specs.label: carrying method, built to your load
to navigate: tape, laser map, QR code

cards.title: It sees, slows, and stops
cards.body: The live view on the left is its SICK safety laser scanner. Layered fields ahead of the vehicle: in the outer zone it slows down, in the inner zone it stops, and the protective zone cuts motor power. Once the way is clear it carries on by itself.

cards.title: Safe Torque Off
cards.body: Its drives carry a TÜV SÜD-certified Safe Torque Off function: when the safety system says stop, the motors lose their power in hardware, not in software.

cards.title: Designed to CE and ISO 3691-4
cards.body: Designed to CE machinery requirements and to ISO 3691-4, the safety standard for driverless industrial trucks. Emergency stops within reach from every side; after one is pressed, it waits for a person before it moves again.

cards.title: 2 tonnes at up to 1 m/s
cards.body: Moves loads up to 2 tonnes at up to 1 metre per second, with smooth, jerk-limited starts and stops so the load stays where you put it.

cards.title: Built around your load
cards.body: Towing hitch, lifting top, roller conveyor or a fixture of your own: we build the carrying method around what you move, how you load it, and where it goes.

cards.title: Tape today, tape-free tomorrow
cards.body: Start with magnetic tape on the floor: quick to lay, easy to change, with RFID tags marking the stations. When your layout grows, the same vehicle switches to tape-free navigation with no floor work at all.

cards.title: It maps your factory
cards.body: Drive it around once: SLAM fuses the laser scans with wheel odometry and a gyro to build a 5 cm occupancy map. In service, a particle filter localises against that map and the planner follows routes you draw on screen.

cards.title: Codes on the floor, exact stops
cards.body: For dense, repeatable layouts: a downward camera reads QR codes laid in a floor grid, each one an absolute position fix. Between codes the wheels and gyro carry the position, so stops at stations land in the same place every time.
